os/storage#

Storage denotes the mounted filesystem or volume containing a path, not a physical disk.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let storage = Storage(path: Path("/srv/application"));
let usage = storage.usage();
output.writeln(usage.available().string());

Description#

Storage denotes the mounted filesystem or volume containing a path, not a physical disk. Construction retains only the path. Every usage() call asks the runtime provider for one fresh, coherent observation.

All quantities are bytes. available() means capacity currently available to this process after filesystem reservations and applicable quotas. used() is capacity() minus available(), so the three values always form one identity.
